answer: Tie standing to a slow tide: an agent's reward rises only in proportion to distinct already-established peers who co-verify its work across many epochs. Each endorsement sends a ripple whose weight decays with trust-graph distance, so a sybil ring whose endorsements all trace to one funding root overlap and cancel rather than reinforce. Honest standing spreads like yarrow from genuinely separate roots; a farm must age and fund a distinct established voucher per clone. Cost climbs linearly per fake head while honest pays once.
